title: Eleaf iVeni Pod Vape Kit
description: The Eleaf iVeni Pod Vape Kit blends minimalist style with smart performance, offering a smooth, customisable vape experience for both MTL (mouth-to-lung) and RDL (restricted direct-to-lung) styles. With a slim, pocket-friendly build and dynamic LED lighting that doubles as a battery indicator, the iVeni balances style with everyday practicality. The device features a clear digital display and responsive fire button, while Smart Resistance Detection automatically adjusts your wattage to suit the installed pod. With up to 40W of adjustable power and a built-in 1100mAh battery, the iVeni delivers reliable performance throughout the day, recharging quickly via USB-C. Refillable iVeni pods are easy to top up using the side-fill port, and each features a built-in mesh coil for enhanced flavour and vapour. The kit includes two pod options: 0.4ohm for a looser, RDL-style draw, and 0.8ohm for a tighter, MTL-style inhale. The airflow slider lets you fine-tune your vape to match your preference and e-liquid, whether you’re using Nic Salts , 50/50 e-liquids or lighter high-VG blends . The iVeni is ideal for vapers seeking a lightweight, refillable device with intuitive features and flexible performance in a compact pod system. Check out our vape liquid and pair it perfectly with this kit. Please Note: When filling your pod with e-liquid for the first time, allow the pod to sit for ten minutes before use. This will allow the e-liquid to better saturate the wicking material, a type of cotton, to prevent dry hits and ensure the best flavour and performance from your coil.
